lanes.name: Future-Bass Lift / Impact v1
lanes.style: Dark trap-soul future bass, 140–145 BPM. Let the uploaded sample act as the song gene: expose its hook in a sparse intro, keep its contour recognizable, then return it as a call-and-response drop melody. Punchy four-on-the-floor kick, crisp off-beat hats, short snare-roll build and precise sidechain pulse. Clean sub-bass synth supplies body; percussive synth stabs and one focused detuned saw lead answer the source without covering it. Build from low density to an explosive drop with a clear rhythmic hook, then withdraw and return with one altered ending. If the source is guitar or voice, preserve its human attack as the memory carrier. Dark club energy with emotional lift, not static atmosphere. Controlled low end, defined mids, transient clarity and short tails; wide at the drop but centered in the foundation.
